lcc_original: 永恆主上帝對女人說：『你幹的甚麼事阿？』女人說：『是蛇誘騙了我，我纔喫了。』
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主: LCC renders YHWH as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord), a systematic LCC convention
神<WH0430> → 上帝: LCC renders אֱלֹהִים as 上帝 consistently, unlike UNV's 神

引誘我<WH05377> → 誘騙了我: SN attached after full phrase including object 我 and aspect particle 了, mirroring UNV's post-object attachment pattern; 了 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent
是 before 蛇 in LCC is a Chinese focus/copula marker ('It is the snake that…') with no Hebrew correspondent; left unannotated
UNV's 是甚麼 introduces the question copula 是 without an SN tag; LCC omits this copula, so 甚麼<WAH04100> attaches directly in place
